text: Stendarr's Hammer is a two-handed blunt weapon and an artifact of Stendarr. It is enchanted to increase damage dealt and decrease the wielder's Fatigue with every hit. With a hundred-point maximum chop damage, this weapon has the highest maximum damage of all melee weapons in and expansion packs. It is also the most massive weapon available (over ten times heavier than a Daedric Warhammer, the heaviest weapon available without expansion packs). With only a hundred points of item health Stendarr's Hammer is also extremely fragile, and will likely break within a few hits if used in combat.

Stuhn, the God of Ransom, is the Nordic precursor to Stendarr and brother of Tsun. Shield-thane of Shor, Stuhn was a warrior god that fought against the Aldmeri pantheon. He showed Men how to take and the benefits of taking prisoners of war. In the Ancient Nordic Pantheon, Stuhn was worshiped as the Whale, one of the Hearth Gods.

Strong Frost Shield is an Alteration spell in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental frost, providing resistance to Frost Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.

Strong Shock Shield is an Alteration spell in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental shock, providing resistance to Shock Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.

Strong Fire Shield is an Alteration spell in that surrounds the caster with a shield of elemental fire, providing resistance to Fire Damage, and damaging nearby adversaries for 10% of the effect's magnitude.

Style Materials are Crafting items in . Style Materials determine the visual style of armor, weapons and shields, assuming the appropriate motif has been read. All Style Materials can be obtained from random loot containers as well as from deconstructing weapons, armor, or clothing crafted in that particular style. They can also be bought from merchants. Some of the materials require 10 of their unrefined parts to create one material.
Stulga is an Orsimer leatherworker residing in Stonetooth Fortress, Betnikh. She has a stall at the market near the docks, where she sells various leather armor items.
Strength of the Father is a quest available in . In the depths of Atanaz Ruins the Vestige came across the corpse of Gordag, cooked in his armor by a beast that dwells there.
Suhr is a Khajiit part of The Prowler's crew. He was captured by Sea Vipers and brought to their ship, the Dread Halcyon, in order to serve as sacrifice for their rituals.
Sunderflame is a dungeon set in . It is a Medium Armor set, and can be obtained in City of Ash. Generic pieces are in the Daedric Style.

Studded Dragonscale Armor is a set of light armor that appears in Creation Club and is a part of the Alternative Armors – Dragonscale creation. It can be crafted using dragon scales iron ingots, leather and leather strips. It is the most powerful set of light armor available, more powerful than both dragonscale armor and amber armor. Unlike most other armor sets, however, there is no shield.

The Sword-Singers were a group of Yokudans who were led by Frandar Hunding; after the Battle of the Singers, they left their homeland and traveled across the ocean, to what is now called Hammerfell. The Sword-Singers were legendary swordsmen, the most elite of which were part of a sub-group known as the Ansei. The most well-known and revered group of the Ansei was known as the Order of Diagna, which was led by Gaiden Shinji, the first blademaster and founder of the Imperial City Arena. It is rumored that a rebelling group of Ansei, known as the Hiradirge, were responsible for the sinking and consequent destruction of Yokuda, though it is possible that the disaster was natural.

Sur Surishpi is a Dunmer Scout who resides outside of Vos, and is a trainer in Long Blade, Athletics and Block. The Calm Humanoid spell is needed in order for the Nerevarine to receive training from him.

A sword is a straight or curved weapon consisting of a bladed edge or often two bladed edges. It can be used for cutting, slashing, slicing, thrusting, jabbing, stabbing and piercing and can be one-handed or two-handed. In Tamriel, expertise in the use of all kinds of swords fall under the Blade skill, and masters of Blade are one-of-a-kind. The following are the types of swords, followed by the weapon quality, and the characteristics of each:
The Sword of the Crusader is recovered from Sir Berich's Wraith in Underpall Cave during the quest "The Sword of the Crusader."
Sword of Jyggalag is a leveled unique claymore found in . This is the sword Jyggalag used in the battle against the Hero during the quest The End of Order.
The Supple Ancient Nord Bow is a bow in . It is a stronger version of the Ancient Nord Bow.
Svana Far-Shield is a Nord merchant who lives in Riften. She works for her aunt, Haelga, at Haelga's Bunkhouse.

Syndus is a Bosmer weapons and armor merchant who runs a shop in The Ragged Flagon. He becomes available after completing the first available city influence quest given by Delvin Mallory for the Thieves Guild. His shop is in an alcove just south of the entrance from the Ratway.

Suvaris Atheron is a Dunmer employed by Torbjorn Shatter-Shield. Suvaris lives in Windhelm and can be found in the Atheron Residence, in the New Gnisis Cornerclub, or running the Shatter-Shield Office at the Windhelm Docks. She is the sister of Aval Atheron and Faryl Atheron.
Sylvan Barkshield is a shield in . It can be found as random loot starting at level 17.
Sword of Agustas is a unique enchanted Nordic claymore that belonged to Agustas. It can be found next to his remains in the northwest room of the Arenim Ancestral Tomb.

Supply Route Problems is a quest in . The new supply ship has arrived at the dock in Raven Rock, but the captain, Baro Egnatius, won't budge without some sort of extra payment. Falco has no intention of paying him, and instead wants the Nerevarine to talk sense into him.
Sword and Board is a passive skill in the One Hand and Shield skill line in .

The Sweetbreeches are an enchanted piece of Medium Armor the Vestige receives the Sweetbreeches upon completion of the quest "The Wandering Minstrel."
Suriel the Smith is a Breton residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra, in . He is found in the indoor market Iron Mine Arms & Armor working, but he has nothing to sell.
Supernal Reverie Staff is an enchanted two handed staff rewarded to the Vestige after completing the quest "Rozenn's Dream."
Supply Ship is a wrecked ship situated on the west coast in the region of Isinfier Plains.

Sword Saint's Choker is a necklace in obtained from the Prophet after competing the quest "Valley of Blades." The Choker was interred within the Ancestral Crypt of the Valley of Blades and previously worn by a Sword Saint.
Swift-Light is an Argonian fighter of the Ebonheart Pact found in Fort Amol.

Sword-Singer is an overland set dropped in Alik'r Desert in . It was added with the release of One Tamriel. It is a Medium Armor set. Generic pieces are in the Redguard Style.

Sword-Singer Navid is a Ra Gada Sword-Singers ghost encountered in a Na-Totambu's Landing in Alik'r Desert. Navid was in-love with Sayeedeh, but she loved another, a man named Ihlqub. While Ihlqub practiced his bow at the beach, Navid sneaked behind him, and slew him with a sacred blade. He regretted his action, and once he reached his tent in Yaghoub's beachhead, he fell on his sword in shame.

Sword Initiate is a generic Initiate character residing in .
Sword of the Inferno is an item card in , introduced in the FrostSpark Collection set.

The Sword Saint's Blade is a greatsword in obtained from Cadwell at the conclusion of the quest "God of Schemes" if Sai Sahan was sacrificed. The Sword Saint's Blade was inscribed by Sahan with prayers to the Alik'r Sword Saints.
Sword's Point Watchtower is a striking locale that appears Western Skyrim.

The Sword of the Lunar Bastion is an sword in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Sword may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Sword is a part of the Lunar Bastion item set.

The Sword of Alkosh is a sword in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Sword may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Sword is a part of the Roar of Alkosh item set.

The Sword of Twilight Remedy is an sword in obtained from the Maw of Lorkhaj trial. The Sword may be dropped by bosses or obtained from the Dro-m'Athra's Burnished Coffer or Dro-m'Athra's Shining Coffer during the course of the quest "Into the Maw." The Sword is a part of the Twilight Remedy item set.

Sword-Singer's Redoubt is a player home in . It is a manor located just east of Satakalaam in the Alik'r Desert, on the border with Bangkorai. This house can be accessed from both zones, with the Bangkorai entrance located just south of Hallin's Stand, and west of Twin Arches. One however, can only fast travel to the Alik'r Desert entrance.
Talis Drurel is a Dunmer barbarian and a member of House Redoran who resides in the Vivec, Redoran Canton. He is a trainer in Athletics, Block, and Medium Armor.
Taluro Athren is a Dunmer living in the Ghostgate. He is a member of House Redoran and medium trainer in Long Blade, Axe, and Blunt Weapon.

Takes-In-Light was an Argonian sorceress who joined Atmah's expedition to the Labyrinthian. She appears during "The Staff of Magnus," the penultimate College of Winterhold quest. Although she accompanied her fellow students to the Labyrinthian, she was not totally convinced it was an intelligent decision, worriedly asking Savos Aren before entering the crypt, "What...What if there are things guarding this place," only to be reconciled by Atmah, and said they could hold out against whatever may be within the fortress. However, during one of the fights within the ruin, she became seriously wounded, and although she attempted to continue onward, she became the third to succumb to the Labyrinthian. The remaining mages initially refused to leave her, but nonetheless they continued on.
Syrabane's Grip is an overland set in . It is a Light Armor set found in Grahtwood. Generic items in this set are in the High Elf Style.

In , a tank is one of the three main types of group players whose role involves protecting the group from attackers, much like healers. Tanks are "meat shields," so to speak, putting themselves between monsters and the rest of the group. The other main roles in most groups are damage dealers and healers. Below is a primer for Veteran Rank Players on tanking, but any player of any level can follow it.
Tahmin of the Sideways Blade is an Anka-Ra found in the tomb chamber beneath Anka-Ra's Mettle. While alive he was a champion of Emperor Tarish-zi.
Talam Sethran is a Dunmer, and the bandit leader of the Greencap Bandits. He is weak to axe and poison damage.
Talfyg's Treachery is a light armor item set in . It can be obtained in Castle Thorn.

Tedryn Brenur is a Dunmer master-at-arms and a tough of the Camonna Tong. He is found on the roof of the Council Club in Balmora. Tedryn can train in long blade, short blade, and blunt weapon.
Targoth's Shield is a shield the Vestige receives after completing the quest "Tormented Souls."
Tazgol's Ancestral Axe is a battle axe received after completing the quest "Carzog's Demise."
Taskmaster Elitai is a Dunmer Tank, and one of the leaders of the Pit Rats found in Darkshade Caverns I in Deshaan.
Tavofi is a Redguard fighter residing outside the Canton of St. Olms the Just in Vivec City on Vvardenfell. She offers no unique dialogue.
Telvanni Hood is a Light Armor headpiece found in . It is given by Beron Telvanni for helping him lift the spellplague in Heimlyn Keep. It is part of the Silks of the Sun item set.
Tarkatix of the Crimson Blade is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He primarily uses melee attacks.
Tanned Netch Leather is a miscellaneous item in that is a part of the Netch Leather Armor Creation Club content.
Tertia Viducia is an Imperial smith and the owner of The March Rider in Cheydinhal. She has a variety of weapons and armor for sale, as well as the unique steel cutlass, Captain Kordan's Saber.
Tervur Braven is a Dunmer Trader who resides in his shop in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton. He sells armor, weapons, clothing, potions, and others. His base gold is 400.
Temple of the Eight is a temple and set crafting location located in the region of Grahtwood, northwest of Elden Root. Armor of the Seducer may be crafted here.
Ten Mountains Armory is an armor shop that appears in the city of Evermore.
Thalia is a Redguard blacksmith residing in Belkarth, Craglorn. She can be found at the Waste-Walker's Forge, selling her wares.
Telvanni Warsash is an item found in . It is a sash of Light Armor, and is part of the Silks of the Sun item set.
The Best Defense is an armor shop located in the Imperial City Market District. It sells both light and heavy armor, both have their own vendors.

The Antipodean Hammer is a side quest activated after obtaining either an Amber or Madness Matrix, or by visiting either Cutter at Cutter's Weapons in Crucible, or Dumag gro-Bonk at The Missing Pauldron in Bliss. As materials can be obtained indefinitely, this quest cannot be completed and cannot be removed from the journal without the use of console commands.
Tharwab is a Redguard residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. He is found standing beside the ship waiting for the captain.
The Bat and Sword Pub is a tavern within the region of Alcaire in High Rock.
The Arch-Mage is an item set that appears in . It is a Light Armor set. It can be obtained in Cyrodiil.
The Beaver and Sword Hostel is a tavern within the region of Dwynnen in High Rock.

The Ascendant Champion is a character residing in Sword's Rest Isle. She is a member of the Ascendant Order and the primary antagonist of the prologue quests, being responsible for the death-enchanted medallions sent to the Alliance peace talk representatives.

The Blade of Nerevar is one of the quests in the main questline of , after "The Missing Hand." Lady Almalexia, satisfied that none may now challenge her power, requests that the Nerevarine reforge Trueflame, the famed sword of Nerevar.
The Broken Spearhead is a quest available in . The Vestige needs to find someone on board the ship and take them to Stros M'Kai, and find Captain Kaleen.
The Bloody Scupper is a pirate ship, located south of Koeglin Lighthouse, in Stormhaven.
The Blasted Breton is a ship in that is found in the town of Alten Corimont, Shadowfen. The Alten Corimont branches of the Fighters Guild and the Mages Guild as well as an inn can be found here.
The Black Sword Lodge is a tavern in the Anticlere region of High Rock.
The Bright Blade of Captain Castatil: Scene VI is a book in .

The Cursed Captain is a quest in . Thormoor Gray-Wave was cursed by Geilir the Mumbling. Thormoor was a ship captain, but fell asleep and crushed a ship. All the family of Geilir died in that disaster. After that, Thormoor Gray-Wave was cursed and never can sleep.

The Dainty Sload is a quest available in in which the Dragonborn must frame the captain of a trade ship for possessing banned items because he cheated Erikur, Jarl Elisif the Fair's thane and the Thieves Guild's client.
The Dangerous Past is a quest available in . A courier will approach and sends word that the fighter's guildmaster wishes meet the Vestige as soon as possible.

__NOTOC__ ---- Friends, scholars, students.... Grave news recently reached my Tower in the far east. I received a letter from a Master Blade that Uriel Septim, Emperor of Imperial conquered Tamriel, has been . I must render his name secret, as he is a shadow agent of the Blades. To my disappointment, I have been instructed not to journey to Cyrodiil by the Elder Council. If there are indeed great troubles in the West, then I will be needed in my lands, were that trouble to spread like a wildfire. I fear I would be of little help were I to travel there. It sounds as though they are need of petty politicals, masters of weaponry, and weavers of blaze. I am but an old, weary wizard. My days of adventure are over. I urge you however, if you find yourself worthy of offering aid to the Empire in this time of need, by all means, travel to Cyrodiil and lend your talents. I, as well as my dear friend whom sent me the grave letter, fear for the future of the Empire, and the whole of Tamriel. May The Nine watch over us. Divayth Fyr
The Craven Shield is a powerful Zombie found in the Tombs of the Na-Totambu.
The Dreamsnake is a ship that appears in Abah's Landing in .
The Cursed Weapon is a Temples quest available during the events of . The Agent is tasked with transporting a dangerous weapon, prized by the Orcs, to a temple cleric hidden within a dungeon.
The Dirty sword Inn is a tavern in the Anticlere region of High Rock.

The Dropped Gauntlet is a Vampiric Clan quest available in . The Agent is sent to answer a challenge from a Daedric Prince's Coven, who wish to fight the Agent's vampiric bloodline for underworld supremacy.
The Devil's Sword Inn is a tavern within the region of Dwynnen in High Rock.
The Dwarf and Sword Hostel is a tavern within the region of Dwynnen in High Rock.

The Demon Weapon is a quest that serves as a prologue to in . Abnur Tharn has acquired two halves of the Wrathstone, an ancient tablet with a map depicting the location of a weapon that could potentially end the Three Banners War. He enlists the help of the Vestige to help him locate the weapon so he can end the war.
The Egg and Hammer Inn is a building in Gideon that appears in .
The Faithful Squire is a quest available in . After collecting all the other Crusader relics: the Boots, Gauntlets, Helm, Cuirass, Shield and the Mace, return to the Priory of the Nine.
The Falconer is a shipwrecked Aldmeri Dominion ship that appears in Khenarthi's Roost, Elsweyr.

The Emperor's Blessing is a Restoration staff in obtained from Cadwell at the conclusion of the quest "God of Schemes" if Varen Aquilarios was sacrificed. The Emperor's Blessing was created by Aquilarios during his time as a Moth Priest.
The Feather and Sword Lodge is a tavern within the region of Daggerfall in High Rock.
The Fox and Sword Pub is a tavern within the region of Daggerfall in High Rock.
The Fair Winds is a player home in . It is a large sailing ship home located at the docks in Vastyr in Galen.
The Gray Aegis is a Steel Shield with 100% resistance to magic. This is used by the Altmer who is fought at the hero rank in the Arena.

The Great Chapel of Arkay is located in Cheydinhal. The chapel's staff includes Ohtesse, Inius Colus, Primate Gruiand Garrana, and the honored and respected Errandil, the Living Saint of Arkay, who crusades fervently against necromancy.
The Ghost of Old Hroldan is a quest available in . The Dragonborn must ease the ghost of an ancient Nord warrior by finding Hjalti's sword.
The High King's Forge is a smithing and armor shop located in Wayrest, Stormhaven. It's near the Foal's Rest Stables and the Cloudy Dregs Inn. Inside are two vendors.

The Katariah is a ship in . Docked in the Haafingar Hold, likely named after Katariah I, the former Dunmer Empress during the Third Era. The Katariah appears during "Hail Sithis!" quest and is docked for the rest of the game. To enter The Katariah, the Dragonborn must climb the anchor chain at the ship's stern.
The Icecap is a unique helmet that protects its wearer against frost damage.
The Kagrumez Gauntlet is a miscellaneous quest available in in which the Dragonborn must complete a gauntlet of challenges known as the Kagrumez trials in the Dwemer ruins of Kagrumez.
The Hotspur is a ship located in the Daggerfall Docks. This ship can be used for passage to Davon's Watch.

The Judgement of Veloth is a quest available in . The time to confront Vox has arrived—but it seems that to defeat her, the Vestige need to die by her hammer. The Blessing of Veloth should protect them, but can they return from the dead?
The Laughing Blade is a One-Handed enchanted dagger rewarded to the Vestige upon completion of the quest "The Jester's Joke."
The Knave and Sword Pub is a tavern in the region of Daggerfall, High Rock.
The Juggernaut is an item set in . It is a Heavy Armor set, and can be found in Cyrodiil. Pieces are in the Alliance styles.
The King's Sword Inn is a tavern within the region of Dragontail Mountains in Hammerfell.

The March Rider is a prominent shop in Cheydinhal, which sells Armor and Weapons and the unique steel cutlass, Captain Kordan's Saber. It is run by Tertia Viducia. The shop has a large fireplace next to Tertia, a bookshelf with various items and some books and some barrels with miscellaneous items. Upstairs are the private quarters, with a lounge and a locked bedroom. The bedroom is sparsely decorated with some paintings on the walls. There are two chests with some weapons and personal effects. The lounge has a set dining table and cupboards with food items and a shelf with cutlery and some wine.

The Mad God is one of the quests in the main questline of , after "The Blade of Nerevar." Now armed with the famed sword Trueflame, the Nerevarine is given one final quest by the Lady Almalexia: to kill the Mad God Sotha Sil.
The Lydia is a ship located in the Daggerfall Docks. The ship can be used for passage to Vulkhel Guard.
The Mole And Sword Inn is a city in the region of Menevia, High Rock.
The Morag Tong is an item set in . It can be found in Cyrodiil, and is a Medium Armor set.
The Lucky Sword Inn is a tavern within the region of Dak'fron in Hammerfell.
The Pale Blade is a unique, leveled Ancient Nord Sword that appears in .
The Patchwork Airship is a quest in . Discover the wreckage of The Patchwork Airship on the island of Solstheim.

The Prowler is a Khajiit ship which is run by Captain Jimila. Under Captain Jimila, the crew were hoping for a simple run of purchasing silks and spices, but have been surprised by the unfair dock fees by Dockmaster Qamar during the quest "A Profitable Venture." Some of the crew, including the Captain, can be found on board. Captain Jimila, Bakhig-ja, and Zeriba can be found on the top deck, while Lonel Begnaud can be seen sweeping the floors on the lower deck. The doors to the lower deck are locked by an Intermediate lock and entering will be considered trespassing. At first it is wrecked along the coast, and after completing a set of quests, it has been restored and is ready to travel to Auridon.

The Perfectly Awful Priest is a Daedric artifact quest available in . The Agent is sent on request by the Daedric Regent Azura to "stick a sword ... or something" in a healer preaching against her core principles of egotism, and vanity.

The Perfect Pounce is a ship in . The ship is commanded by Captain Za'ji and First Mate Caska who would later be recruited into the Dragonguard and work closely with the Aldmeri Dominion along with the rest of their crew. The ship later floundered off the coast of High Isle and Amenos in the Systres Archipelago while transporting Queen Ayrenn to attend the peace talks.
The Serpent's Wake is a haunted ship docked in Anvil Harbor.

The Shipwreck Prelude is a House Hlaalu quest concerning the wreckage of the ship Prelude in the Azura's Coast region of Vvardenfell, available to the Nerevarine if they join House Hlaalu during the events of .
The Sea Squall is a ship in that is docked in the harbor of Dawnstar, The Pale.
The Silent Sword is a powerful Zombie found in the Lost City of the Na-Totambu.
The Servile Staff is a powerful Zombie found in the Tombs of the Na-Totambu.
The Ship's Hold Inn is an inn that appears in the town of Alten Corimont.
The Scourge's Mark is a ship docked in Velyn Harbor, Malabal Tor.
The Rusty Argonian Blade is a docked ship that appears in Davon's Watch, Stonefalls.
The Refurbishing Yard is a location that appears in . It can be used to craft the Innate Axiom item set.
The Screaming Sword Inn is a tavern within the region of Alcaire in High Rock.
The Rusty Sword Tavern is a tavern within the region of Dragontail Mountains in Hammerfell.
The Shattered Staff is a quest in about finding four of the eight fragments of the Staff of Towers.
The Silver Cormorant is a ship in located in Western Skyrim.
The Thieves Den (DLC7) is a plug-in for that features a pirate's lost ship and is designed for stealth-based characters. It costs US $1.89 for PC and 150 points on Xbox Live.

The Sword of the Crusader is a quest available in . After collecting all the other Crusader relics: the Boots, Gauntlets, Helm, Cuirass, Shield, and the Mace, the Hero returns to the Priory of the Nine.

The Staff of Magnus is a quest available in . It serves as the seventh quest in the College of Winterhold sequence of quests in which the Dragonborn must recover the Staff of Magnus from the Nordic ruin of Labyrinthian to stop Ancano and stabilize the Eye of Magnus.

Tava's Bounty is a ship located in the docks in the Koeglin Village, Stormhaven. Captain Currod and his crew docked in the middle of the night and where attacked by the slavers who sneaked up on them.
The Spearhead is the ship belonging to Captain Kaleen. The Vestige will help Kaleen to gather her crew again and joins them in the adventures ahead.
The Slippery Scales Armory is an armor shop that appears in the city of Evermore.
The Thrown Gauntlet is an armorer stall located in Fort Amol's Merchant Caravans marketplace. It is currently run by Vestord.
The Tribune's Spear is a ship that appears in . It is located in Quendeluun, Auridon, and is captained by Captain Rela and Centurion Earran.
The Towers' Remains is a quest in about finding four of the eight fragments of the Staff of Towers.
The Strong Shield is a stall in the Royal Bazaar in the city of Mournhold, Deshaan.
The Sword, Backpack and Nix-Hound Bundle is a Creation Club bundle in . Alternatively the bundle was usually acquired with 650 .
The Sword of Clan Ice-Blade is a book in / that is a part of the Creation Club addon The Gray Cowl Returns!.
The Staff of Hasedoki is a side quest in and is part of the Staff of Hasedoki Creation Club content.
The Weapon Delivery is a miscellaneous quest given by the Thieves Guild member Lucan Ostorius in . It involves a shipment of weapons that must be delivered to its receiver in Ald'ruhn.
The Whistling Hammer is a woodworker shop that appears in the city of Evermore.
The Velvet Lash is a ship that appears in . It is located at the Bal Foyen Dockyards.
The White Sword Hostel is a city in the region of Menevia, High Rock.

The Worm's Raiment is a dungeon set in . It is a light armor set, and can be found in Vaults of Madness. Generic armor pieces are in the original Worm Cult Style, and generic weapon/shield pieces are in the Soul-Shriven Style.
The Windstorm is a Ship docked in the port of the town of Seyda Neen, and is the first location visited if entering Vvardenfell through the aforementioned town.
The Vigilant One is a bow found in . It is part of the Sheer Venom set.
The Unfortunate Sword Lodge is a tavern within the region of Dragontail Mountains in Hammerfell.

The Thorn Shield, along with the Knights of the Thorn Medallion, is the marking symbol of a Knight of the Thorn. It is a steel shield with the mark of the Knights of the Thorn on the front and back. The mark is a sword wrapped with thorny vines. This shield is similar to a Knights of the Thorn Shield but is enchanted.

Thieves Guild Armor is a light armor set found in . The armor is mostly made of leather and is lightweight, making it ideal for the agile shadow-hugging thief. It offers higher defense than Elven or Scaled Armor and is available extremely early in the game after 2 non combat quests. Incidentally, the armor cannot be disenchanted. Upgraded with Leather, the Thieves Guild Armor fortifies lockpicking, pickpocket, and carrying capacity when worn. Pieces can only be found within the Ragged Flagon - Cistern.
Threefold Shield is an Elven shield found as random loot that has a reflect spell.
Thieves Guild Boots are a piece of light armor and part of the Thieves Guild armor set.
The Thieves Guild Gloves are a piece of light armor and part of the Thieves Guild armor set found in .
The Thieves Guild Hood is a piece of light armor and part of the Thieves Guild armor set found in . It is visually identical to the Torturer's Hood.
Third Barrier is an Alteration spell in that creates a magical shield around the caster's entire body, increasing their armor rating.
Thews of the Harbinger is a Tel Var set in . It can be bought from Tel Var merchants. Pieces are Heavy Armor in the Nord Style.

Ticklebritch is a disease that can be contracted by using the hoe weapon that was included in the Mehrunes' Razor plug-in. The weapon also has a 40% chance on strike to inflict the disease to the target. This disease affects attributes such as Endurance and Personality, which are important for Bartering and lasting longer in a fight. This disease should be cured right away as it affects bartering and how long one can survive in a fight.
The Tiger Fang Shield is an enchanted light shield in with a Reflect Damage enchantment.

A Throwing Knife is a type of thrown projectile weapon in . Use of a throwing knife is governed by the Marksman skill. Throwing knives stack in the inventory and must be equipped. Damage inflicted by throwing knives increases with each level in Marksman, and based on the type used. Throwing knives can be found in enchanted varieties.
Thunderous Plate Mail was a named heavy armor item set found in . At some point it was discontinued. The Storm Knight's Plate set is quite similar.

A Throwing Star is a type of thrown projectile weapon in . Use of a throwing star is governed by the Marksman skill. Throwing stars stack in the inventory and must be equipped. Damage inflicted by throwing stars increases with each level in Marksman, and based on the type used. throwing stars can be found in enchanted varieties.
Thulvald Axe-Head is a Nord residing in Thulvald's Logging Camp in Eastmarch
Thunderbug's Carapace is an overland set in . It can be obtained in Malabal Tor. Generic pieces are Heavy Armor in the Primal Style.
Thundefell is a legendary, divine, versatile bashing weapon found in . It shares its appearance with the Glass Mace. It could be bought during the event quest "The Sundered Caves".
Titanborn Strength is a dungeon set in . It is a Medium Armor Icereach Coven Style set, and can be found in Icereach. It is somewhat analogous to True-Sworn Fury.
Timeless Blessing is an Asylum weapon set in . It drops as Restoration Staves in the Apostle Style from Saint Olms the Just at Normal difficulty in Asylum Sanctorium.
Tlom is an Argonian found inside The Egg and Hammer Inn at Gideon in .
To Raise the Living is a book in that is part of the Staff of Hasedoki Creation Club content.
Torches are items of illumination. Equipping a torch occupies the shield-hand. Torches extinguish after an extended duration of time has passed or when fully submerged in water.
The Torc of Labyrinthian is a quest item in used to unlock Labyrinthian in "The Staff of Magnus".

Tova Shatter-Shield is a Nord in who may usually be found at the market in the southwest Stone Quarter, Candlehearth Hall, or walking nearby. At night, she heads to the House of Clan Shatter-Shield, where she can also be found during the day.

Torbjorn Shatter-Shield is the patriarch of Clan Shatter-Shield of Windhelm. Generally found in the Blacksmith Quarters of Windhelm's market district, Torbjorn serves as an Expert-trainer in Two-Handed. If the Dragonborn kills Nilsine in the Dark Brotherhood questline, Tova will commit suicide, leaving him as the only living member of the family.
Torolf was a Nord lumberjack who lived in Helgen. He and his wife Matlara both died in the attack by Alduin. He is the son of Froki Whetted-Blade, and father of Haming.
Tonas Telvani is a Dunmer Shipmaster found at Tel Mora docks near her ship, Pole Star.
Torturer's Assistant is an Imperial found in Helgen Keep. He wears a set of Imperial light armor, with the exception of the helmet as well as an iron mace.
